name: MT-Bench
description: A multi-turn conversation benchmark containing 80 challenging questions across 8 categories: writing, roleplay, reasoning, math, coding, extraction, STEM, and humanities. Answers are scored by GPT-4 as a judge on a 1–10 scale. Designed to evaluate conversational ability and instruction-following across multiple dialogue turns.
typical_sota_score: ~9.0–9.5 out of 10 (saturated; a constant-response 'null model' scored 9.55 in research)
reputation: Introduced LLM-as-judge paradigm widely adopted in the field; published by LMSYS/UC Berkeley at NeurIPS 2023; widely cited; now largely saturated and superseded by Arena-Hard
notes: Saturated — top models cluster near the ceiling, and a 'null model' study showed constant responses could score 9.55/10. Superseded by Arena-Hard which uses 500 more challenging Chatbot Arena queries with 89.1% agreement with Arena Elo. MT-Bench pioneered the LLM-as-judge evaluation paradigm now used in many other benchmarks. Published at NeurIPS 2023.
